judged_text: The new add_members endpoint silently skips nonexistent usernames (User.find_by_username returns nil and nothing is added), and this diff deleted the old patch-based tests that pinned that silent-skip behavior without replacing them. A future change that makes add_members raise or 404 on an unknown username (or worse, adds a user by a different lookup) breaks user-facing behavior with no test failing; the previous suite explicitly covered 'succeeds silently when adding non-existent users' and that guarantee is now unverified.

adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, the loop `usernames.split(",").each` uses `User.find_by_username(username)` and only calls `group.add(user)` inside `if user = ...`, so unknown usernames are silently ignored. The previous controller spec explicitly tested this silent-skip behavior for the old PATCH-based membership update (`"succeeds silently when adding non-existent users"`), but that test block was removed and no equivalent test was added under the new `.add_members` specs. This leaves a user-visible behavior (silent ignore vs error) unpinned by tests.
